text:
encops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: snapshot-restore-failure for tenant-44 (restore_id=rst-2026-03-22-01). Error=DecryptError, metadata_ttl_mismatch

noah: seeing this pop up across two restores. started ~01:12 UTC after last-night KMS rotation. anyone else?

emma: which snapshots exactly? full DB snapshots or S3 tarballs?

sanjay: quick check: both. example head call: 
```
$ aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups --key tenant44/2026-03-21/snapshot.tar.gz
{ "Metadata": { "enc-key-id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd-rotated", "enc-meta-ttl": "1679550720" } }
```
metadata ttl is older than rotation time. decrypt attempts return KMS AccessDenied for `uploader-serviceacct` after rotation.

iris: we removed the legacy grant for `uploader-serviceacct` as part of the rotation job (PR #4123). looks like some objects still reference the old key id in metadata -> can't find matching grant.

noah: that matches. so snapshots created before rotation reference old key id but rely on grant that we revoked. two paths: restore grant or rewrap objects with new key. which is faster for production restore?

emma: re-issuing a grant for the old key is fastest short-term. we should verify the old CMK still exists and key policy allows grant creation by ops. run: `aws kms list-grants --key-id <old-key>` and `aws kms create-grant --key-id <old-key> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111:role/uploader-serviceacct --operations Decrypt`

sanjay: ran `list-grants` — returned empty for old-key (grant was pruned). tried to `create-grant` and got `AccessDenied` because the rotation principal (infra-rotation-role) also updated key policy to tighten create-grant.

oncall: from incident standpoint — do we have customer impact? how many restores failed? estimated 6 restores in last hour, 2 customers blocked. classify P2 unless it escalates. open runbook `restore-rollback-or-grant`

encops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-22-44. Severity=P2. Links: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-03-22-44

iris: two options: 1) Modify key policy to temporarily allow ops to create the grant for uploader role (fast but touches key policy) 2) Import and use a legacy grant token if we had recorded it (we do not) 3) Re-wrap snapshots (slow, expensive).

noah: prefer option 1 short-term with strict audit & rollback: add a temporary statement allowing `kms:CreateGrant` for `infra-ops` for 1 hour, create grant, test restores, then revert policy. Need approvals from security lead.

emma: audit log check: run CloudTrail query for `Decrypt` Denied events from 01:00–02:00 UTC. sample CloudTrail lookup: `eventName=Decrypt AND errorCode=AccessDenied AND resource=arn:aws:kms:...`

sanjay: did that — found ~18 `AccessDenied` Decrypt events tied to old grant attempts. attached snippet: `2026-03-22T01:14:02Z Decrypt AccessDenied uploader-serviceacct arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd-rotated`

iris: note for postmortem: rotation job removed grants before key policy got updated to allow grant recreation by infra. sequence bug. add to action items.

oncall: agreed. immediate remediation: iris, can you open a short-lived key policy change and ping sec-lead for 10 minute approval? we need a 15-min window to validate.

iris: doing it now. PR: https://git.internal/policies/rotate-key-policy/PR-789 — added statement for `arn:aws:iam::111:role/infra-ops` with `kms:CreateGrant`. will tag `secure-approvers` for rapid review.

noah: after grant created we should run a test restore for tenant-44 and one other tenant. if successful, run a targeted cleanup to rewrap older snapshots with new CMK for long-term fix.

emma: long-term followups: 1) update rotation playbook to ensure grant recreation order 2) add automated check that validates snapshot metadata key ids post-rotation 3) add alert when `Decrypt` AccessDenied spike occurs for snapshot restores 4) add a canary process to rewrap a sample snapshot after rotation.

sanjay: also recommend adding an audit log assertion in CI for rotation PRs: require `list-grants`/`create-grant` smoke after policy change.

iris: sec-lead approved the temporary policy. created grant, test restore in prod-cp succeeded at 01:44 UTC. marking incident mitigated — will leave incident open for follow-ups.

encops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-22-44 status=mitigated by iris at 01:44 UTC.

oncall: assigning follow-ups: @emma (rotation playbook update), @sanjay (CI add smoke), @noah (rewrap migration plan), @iris (postmortem + timeline). target ETA EOW.

noah: quick vuln triage note: this is not an exploited vuln but a procedural risk — treat as ops flaw. include timeline + diff for PRs in postmortem.

emma: thanks all. add to postmortem: CloudTrail query and the PR links. closing thread once PMR published. :white_check_mark:
